$comment: The app's scene library (DECISIONS 48, 55): HyperFrames registry components (Apache-2.0), pinned to one commit. scripts/fetch-library.mjs downloads each component's files at build time, checks every file against library.lock.json, and bundles them. Nothing is copied into this repo.
$presets: The Brand wizard's gallery (docs/wizards/brand.md 8): the FRAME.md of each HyperFrames frame preset, same commit, same lock.
$motion: The Motion wizard (docs/wizards/motion.md, docs/motion-wizard.md): background components and HyperFrames' own transition files, same commit, same lock. transitions.json is the curated CSS transition registry HyperFrames ships with its faceless-explainer workflow; overview.md holds its energy and mood tables. Shader transitions come from the @hyperframes/shader-transitions npm package (engine/package.json).
